post.description: The first accepted call atomically creates the replacement session, revokes the old session, queues old-overlay deletion, and writes a ten-minute replay receipt. During that window only this route accepts the cryptographically valid revoked old cookie, and only when its fingerprint, Idempotency-Key, and normalized request hash match the receipt. Such a retry returns the original body and exact Set-Cookie value. Other uses of the revoked cookie are unauthorized.

202.description: Previous session revoked and scoped deletion queued, or exact replay of that original accepted response

x-runtime-security.local-data: No guest cookie is issued or required. The single local workspace is derived from trusted server configuration, and public-demo-only capabilities return capability_disabled.
x-runtime-security.public-demo: GET /config and health probes are unauthenticated. /config establishes the signed guest cookie; application operations then require that cookie, except the narrowly specified reset-replay use of a verified revoked cookie.
